extDescription: Save GIFs from X (Twitter) as real .gif files in one click. Converted locally in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

button.idle: Save as GIF · right-click for presets

toast.noGif: No GIF found here. Right-click a GIF or a post with a GIF
toast.busy: This post's GIF is already being converted

preset.nameTaken: A preset with this name already exists
preset.maxSideRange: Enter a whole number from $1 to $2, or leave empty for the original size
preset.fpsRange: Enter a whole number from $1 to $2, or leave empty for the original frame rate
preset.targetRange: Enter a number from $1 to $2 (MB), or leave empty for no limit
preset.tooMany: You can have up to $1 custom presets

error.noH264: This browser can't decode H.264 video
error.extensionUpdated: The extension was updated. Refresh the page and try again

options.heading: Settings
options.presetsDesc: The selected preset is used when you click the GIF button on a post. Changes apply right away, no need to refresh X.
options.limitHint: You can have up to $1 custom presets. Delete one to create another
options.local: All conversion happens on your device. Nothing is uploaded

form.name: Name
form.rangeHint: Leave empty for no limit. Range $1–$2
form.sizeHint: If it's larger, it's re-encoded with fewer colors, then a lower frame rate, then a smaller size (up to 4 tries). Range $1–$2
form.colorsHint: Fewer colors make smaller files but more banding in gradients
form.ditherHint: Blends colors with a fine dot pattern for smoother gradients; files get slightly larger

save.title: Save location
save.desc: GIFs are saved to your browser's downloads folder. Changes apply right away.
save.folderPlaceholder: Leave empty to save directly to Downloads
save.folderReplaced: Characters like : * ? can't be used in folder names and will become _
save.folderHint: Use / for subfolders. Variables work too, e.g. $1 for a folder per author. Folders always stay inside Downloads
save.fileReplaced: Characters like / : * ? can't be used in file names and will become _
save.noTweetId: Without the post ID, names can clash and the browser adds (1), (2)
save.fileHint: Multiple GIFs in one post get _1, _2 appended. The date is the download date
save.exampleInvalid: Example (changes marked in red aren't saved; downloads still use this)
